evidence: Labeled 'Build system' and 'Windows', modifying CMake configuration files, CI scripts, and build presets to migrate native Windows compilation to clang-cl.
rationale: Migrating native Windows builds and CI from MSVC to clang-cl removes recurring maintenance friction from MSVC internal compiler errors and significantly speeds up CI compile times. It addresses persistent compiler bugs (#31456) and unblocks downstream improvements like inline assembly optimizations on Windows.
